name: rename-function
setup:
printf 'def calc_total(items):
    return sum(items)
' > billing.py && printf 'from billing import calc_total

print(calc_total([1, 2, 3]))
' > main.py
prompt: Rename the function calc_total to compute_total in billing.py and update its caller in main.py. The program must still work.
verify: grep -q compute_total billing.py && grep -q compute_total main.py && ! grep -q calc_total billing.py main.py
